subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new opt-in agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs config plus late-side-effect fence as the core fix for deferred turn-maintenance stalls?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but config surface and session-state fencing are compatibility-sensitive policy choices that automation should not silently approve.

options.title: Accept the opt-in timeout and fence
options.body: Land this PR after maintainer review because it preserves upgrade behavior by default while giving affected operators a bounded recovery path.

options.title: Require a different recovery contract
options.body: Ask for a revision that reuses or derives from existing recovery settings instead of adding a new compaction config key.

options.title: Pause for broader maintenance policy
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want burst coalescing or interactive abort policy designed before adding any timeout knob.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in timeout and fence
recommendation.body: Land this PR after maintainer review because it preserves upgrade behavior by default while giving affected operators a bounded recovery path.
